risk_note: B1-06zm (D10-1225, 规划/05 CT-10 follow-up of CT-10a #3111): linking now judges union_bindings.status through the generated union-binding state machine of @couli/domain. domain/binding-status-transitions.ts drops its hand-written NEXT table; canTransitionBinding keeps its signature (the CT-10a compat test imports it) and asks transitionUnionBinding on every call. union-bindings / binding-risk / admin-union-bindings / deletion-cleanup / merge-release / pdd-authority go through it before their row_version CAS; the six TODOs 'blocked on CT-10 (approvals #26)' are gone. deletion-cleanup and merge-release compute their allowed source states per call after the user lock (formerly at module load); an empty set returns without SQL. Behaviour, error codes (user authorization refused → 50001, nothing written) and concurrency (single writer linking + CAS, concurrent re-read → 30151) unchanged; other unions' restore / unban stay blocked → invalid → active in one operation. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two attempts (r1 spec-test S1: no concurrent different-relation_id case; attempt 2 adds it); red 52 for the right reason; Codex spec-test r1 fail → r2 pass. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round; container rule tests 52/52 green (23 unit + 29 int). Codex money r1 pass, no findings. After merge approvals #26 lapses by its own wording (protected file, left to the orchestrator); two comments outside paths (union-bindings-pdd.ts, link-open-pdd-auth.ts) still mention approvals #26, reported for a small follow-up. No contract, no migration. Written by hand.
